headline: Rams' Stafford addresses Simpson pick, own future after deal
description: Matthew Stafford said Thursday he "appreciated" coach Sean McVay calling to tell him the team was going to draft QB Ty Simpson last month and understands why the Rams selected the former Bama star.

headline: Jaguars' Hunter stays unfazed by noise over his two-way play
description: Just as he has since he was drafted in 2025, the Jaguars' Travis Hunter on Wednesday brushed aside the noise over whether he will or should play on both sides of the ball.
